articles.title: History essay
articles.headline: HISTORY ESSAY DUE OCT 20
articles.subhead: Covers 1,200 words on the Industrial Revolution.
articles.subject: History
articles.author: Aisha K.
articles.body: The History essay is due later this month. Start your outline now and bring a draft paragraph to next week's lesson for feedback.
articles.photo_caption: Pages and projects pile up as the History deadline nears.

articles.title: Project submission
articles.headline: SCIENCE GROUP PROJECT DUE OCT 18
articles.subhead: Covers group work. Required: one shared folder per group.
articles.subject: Science
articles.author: Marcus T.
articles.body: Group projects for Science are due on Sunday evening. Each group submits one shared folder containing the write-up, data sheets and a short reflection from every member.
articles.photo_caption: Assignments wait to be collected for Science.

articles.title: Inter-class football final
articles.headline: INTER-CLASS FOOTBALL FINAL SLATED FOR OCT 17
articles.subhead: Covers final match. Takes place in North Field.
articles.subject: Football
articles.author: Diego R.
articles.body: Our class reaches the inter-class football final on Saturday at North Field. The squad trains after school on Thursday and Friday, and supporters are welcome to bring banners.

articles.title: Field trip
articles.headline: MUSEUM FIELD TRIP CONFIRMED FOR OCT 16
articles.subhead: Covers ancient civilisations gallery. Required: signed permission slip.
articles.subject: History
articles.author: Aisha K.
articles.body:
The class visits the City Museum on Friday to explore the ancient civilisations gallery. The bus leaves the school gate at 8:30, and lunch will be eaten at the museum garden.

Permission slips must be returned to the class teacher before the trip. Students without a slip will stay at school.
articles.photo_caption: The scene at City Museum, ahead of the event.

articles.title: Summative test
articles.headline: SUMMATIVE TEST SET FOR MATH, OCT 13
articles.subhead: Covers chapters 1-4. Required: bring a calculator and two pencils.
articles.subject: Math
articles.author: Priya N.
articles.body:
The Math summative test takes place on Tuesday in Room 204 and covers chapters 1 to 4.

Students should arrive ten minutes early. **No phones** are allowed in the exam room, and desks will be assigned on arrival.

- Bring a calculator and two pencils
- Review the practice set from last week
- Ask questions before Monday's lesson ends
articles.photo_caption: Room 204, where the Math exam will be held.
articles.requirement: Bring a calculator and two pencils
articles.restriction: No phones in the exam room

articles.title: Lab report submission
articles.headline: SCIENCE LAB REPORT DUE OCT 12
articles.subhead: Covers titration experiment. Required: print and staple your report.
articles.subject: Science
articles.author: Marcus T.
articles.body:
Lab reports on the titration experiment are due by the end of today. Hand them in at the Science Lab, printed and stapled, with group names on the cover page.

Late reports lose one grade band for each day they are overdue.
articles.photo_caption: Science Lab, where Science work is handed in.

articles.title: Vocabulary quiz
articles.headline: ENGLISH VOCABULARY QUIZ SET FOR OCT 6
articles.subject: English
articles.author: Priya N.
articles.body: The English vocabulary quiz covered the unit 3 word list. Results will be returned this week.
articles.photo_caption: Room 110, where the English exam will be held.

articles.title: Sports day results
articles.headline: ATHLETICS RESULTS FROM SPORTS DAY ARE IN
articles.subject: Athletics
articles.author: Diego R.
articles.body: Results from sports day are in. Our class finished second overall, with standout performances in the relay and the long jump.
articles.photo_caption: North Field, where the Athletics action will unfold.

articles.title: Library hours extended
articles.headline: SCHOOL LIBRARY HOURS EXTENDED THIS TERM
articles.author: Ms. Fernandez
articles.body:
The School Library now stays open until 5 p.m. on weekdays for the rest of the term, so students can study, print and borrow books after the last lesson.

Please keep conversation low and return borrowed books on time.
articles.photo_caption: A lesson in progress in School Library.
